blockers.description: Arity tower: nf_characterizable_temporal_prior at depth k+2 requires converting depth-(k+1) arity-2 NF existentials to temporal, which involves depth-k arity-3 quantifier conditions. VVecEA2 only handles arity 2. Resolving requires either generalizing V-EA formulas to arbitrary arity (Rabinovich Lemma 3.2.2) or finding a novel decomposition that avoids arity growth.

continuation_context: The critical-path sorry has been narrowed from 'all depths >= 1' to 'depths >= 2'. Depth 0 and depth 1 are sorry-free. The remaining sorry at KampPrior.lean:154 is the succ (succ k') case, requiring arity-3 NF infrastructure. All Phase 2 results (model-independent negation closure) are sorry-free and independently valuable. Prop43.lean provides the sorry-free generic infrastructure (nf_succ_char_formula) that makes the depth-1 case work -- this same infrastructure will handle general k once the arity-2 existential conversion is available at all depths.
